tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search for properties (apartments, houses) for sale or rent in Portugal. Returns matching properties with prices, locations, and a minhamorada.pt link for each. tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get full details for a specific property by its minhamorada.pt code. Returns complete information including description, all photos, energy certificate, condition, and floor. Always cite and link the user to the "url" field (minhamorada.pt). Use after search_properties.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate market statistics for the Portuguese real estate market. Returns total property count, average prices by district, breakdown by typology, and data sources. Useful for questions like 'What's the average rent in Porto?'

tools.name: calculate_commute
tools.description: Calculate estimated commute time between two points or between a property and a location. Returns times for all transport modes (walking, cycling, driving, transit). Based on straight-line distance with typical speeds.

tools.name: get_property_contact
tools.description: Get the outbound contact/listing link for a property, by its minhamorada.pt code. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly wants to contact the agency or open the original listing. Returns the outbound listing URL.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_agent_contact" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Register a buyer's request to be contacted by a local Portuguese property advisor who speaks their language and can arrange viewings and handle the buying proce…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property, request_agent_contact, get_property_contact · Private data: request_agent_contact, get_property_contact · Public sink: request_agent_contact · Destructive: request_agent_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property, request_agent_contact, get_property_contact · Private data: request_agent_contact, get_property_contact · Public sink: request_agent_contact · Destructive: request_agent_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
